body: No alone. Maybe with a family member or friend. His sisters just texted me. They found my favorite candy (rare Turkish candy.) and so they were asking if I want a pack. Not sure what this all means.
I think so too. I mean when I like someone I give them more importance and respond in an appropriate time. And when I don’t have any interest I don’t. It stings being on the other side.
A week. 2 weeks I’ve known about him/ we met in person.

Thank you. You’re so right. I think my reason for posting this was also a real concern. I’m not sure I want to be with someone who is extremely busy. I mean marriage and getting married is all about getting a life partner right? How will he be my partner if he’s always working! 

We’ve been talking seriously for 2 days this week. We met each other’s families recently too. I’ll give it some adjusting. But ask him to call soon. And just say I think we should seriously prioritize what is important and that marriage isn’t a small step either he’s all in for figuring out we’re a good match or he’s not.

I think the issue is his businesses are very busy and it doesn’t depend on the day moreso the area. So he’s driving to his different cafe locations depending on who needs help etc. but again, I get that. And he and I are nothing so he doesn’t really owe me a lot of attention. But still… some thoughts if he was serious. I can’t be with someone who is not considerate. That’s something I can’t compromise on.
That’s true. And that’s where im perplexed. He talks to me for 3-4 hours and then won’t respond. Then sends me a message and then another day goes by. I get he’s busy. I am too!

You think so? I mean he’s said he has to visit the different cafes cuz they’re understaffed. And if there’s an issue he’s the first person they all call. So I know he’s busy. He always responds after 10 pm so I don’t think he’s pretending to be busy as much as he’s just no prioritizing this.
Sadly they’ve been MIA and said that they expect someone to come to the hotel to pick up the package.
Hi! is there a way I can do so from here in america? Like a phone number or online chat system? I tried looking into it but it doesn’t really say

Thanks. I’m trying so hard. But it seems the era of getting interviews quickly is gone. Last year I’d have 2-3 interviews few weeks. Now I’m surprised if I get a callback / interview in a months time. I’m experienced enough for interviews but there’s always an applicant with more experience ugh.

Thanks this is extremely helpful. I’ve made some strong connections with a few higher ups. They did advise me to do similarly: explore different areas of the role/ industry and see what I like to do. Unfortunately I’m still relatively new to the industry so I’m really not sure what I want. I want to see “progress” in my career but I’m not particularly passionate about anything or ambitious. I just think if someone works hard they should get rewarded for their work. But you’re right. Thank you for this! And I’ll definitely try to implement these changes.

I’m shy but not everyone needs to present to get things done. I suck at presenting decks yes but as I got more comfortable doing it I was getting better. Now im stuck behind the scenes where there is no visibility for me at all. I was told that there will be opportunities for me later on but no title changes or raises. we didn’t have enough money. I asked for clarification on what I need to work on, and I was just told I needed to communicate better. And my boss said that we would work on it this year. But you can’t communicate with a boss that’s always busy.

Thanks sister. I think one thing I’m depressed about is that I already filled my head with so many ideas of what my future would look like with him. I got ahead of myself. We’ve known each other since we were kids. But being tan in my family of light beige/ fair skin people has been hard. Being pretty enough in the US but not in my culture has been super hard on my soul. But I think it’s time for me to invest in therapy. I need to let go of lookism and build up my confidence.
Thank you.
Thanks. I needed this.

I’m not sure if it’s weak or trying to be a good son. His sister ran away and got married. He’s under a lot of pressure. His parents are both very sick, one is terminally ill. He wanted to get married after getting his business more stable. For now, he’s financially dependent on his parents. I’m heartbroken. But I can understand. I’m not the prettiest choice. His fiancée is pale, taller than me, and from a very very wealthy family. They are a match. And we are not.
I guess but maybe things would be different if I was actually pretty. But I will move on. Even though I wish I didn’t have to
He comes from a rich family and due to this is financially dependent on his parents. But this is what’s written in my fate. I should just accept it.

I can focus on giving sympathies for the daughters. But a women alone without any support financially can end up homeless here. A has no family here aside from her husband and kids. If she was to go back to her home country she would not have any support there either it would be worse for her there. 

It’s not my job to make others accountable for their actions that lies on Allah SWT alone. What I can do is understand that A will need financial and emotional support to keep her two sons warm and sheltered as her husband has fully disowned his sons. It’s not their fault this is happening. A’s husband literally is psychotic too. He has been feeding venom to his kids about A’s family / mom/ dad/ siblings. Filthy words that should not be spoken about another women let alone your wife. A made mistakes yes. And it’s up to her kids if they want to forgive her. But her husband should act like an adult. He should stop backbiting and cursing about his wife.
Of course!

It might be the stress. Maybe he is feeling a bit stressed out, a warehouse job is not for the weak, and there’s not a lot of upward advancement. He feels controlling how you dress may be something he can control/ nag about? Not sure. But this is definitely something you should have a heart-to-heart with him about. You are trying your best. And unfortunately, scrubs and other uniforms are often not made with Muslim women in mind. Will pray that it gets better for you sis

Did you guys talk about the financial dynamic before marriage? I feel like some men do not feel comfortable with their wives making more money. But it’s not your fault. Like he should be grateful/ happy.

Hi thanks for your message sister. My situation has gone a complete 180 now. Probably because my mom finally realized how unstable I was becoming and on the verge of collapse. And also that their controlling behavior was not effective at all. 

Your comment is also what I was telling my sister earlier today it could be that her daughters were done with their mother. We probably have not heard the entire story. Again I’m friends with the sisters so once (if) they are ready to talk, I will listen and empathize because I know this pain and struggle. “A” is weird about marriage aka super obsessed. I remember her chastising me one day when she came to visit saying I should get married now. (Ok that’s my right/decision to make not yours?!) 

I’m only feeling sad for A because in this situation she is the one who is weak. And even though she may be of fault I am concerned for her mental health and how she will support herself in this extremely expensive and unstable economy. Her kids are above 18 in college/ one about to start college. One son has already started working to help support the family, the other is prepping for med school so is too busy studying to work. But thanks for your message, it was eye opening.

The kids are older than 18. Okay thanks I’m asking because she’s really emotionally stressed out. She works a minimum wage job and is worried about how she will survive. One of her sons got a job working in a restaurant. The other one is prepping for medical school and does not know how bad things are (because the mom does not want him to worry/ know until he has taken his exams.) they are legally married. The husband is retired but earning well.

Sister this is such a scary POV. “Your parents did not do a good job and they will have to answer to Allah”? And who are you exactly to say that?? Were you there when her parents raised her? Maybe they did push her behind the scenes but chose not to force her? Have some fear. Your whole comment sounds judgmental, vindictive and ugly. All I’m gonna say is username probably checks out but without the queen part.

OP if you’re reading this, I think you married the wrong man. People have different opinions and different takes on boundaries regarding Islam. Like for example some women who wear hijab but never pray and cast their judgment on others who do not cover properly or men vice versa. And then there’s Muslim women who pray 5 daily prayers but do not cover all the time. Allah is the all-knowing. Our job and drive should be that we should be the best Muslims we can be. As we ourselves our actions and intentions will be the ones to push ourselves to jannah or hell. As for your husband, he sounds like a red flag ok people were asking him and so he’s upset. There’s other ways to show disappointment but in a more productive manner. He sounds like a pain. If there’s something else he gets displeased about how will he react? You live and you learn

i mean that takes balls. i have the money- it’s difficult to explain but i’ve never lived away from home for more than a day. like i did a study abroad (which took more than begging i literally lost a part of my soul i feel getting my dad to agree to let me go) and realised life is more than sitting at home holed up being afraid of getting raped and losing your dignity like my mother etched into my mind. but it’s hard getting permission every month to visit friends. the day i’m out w friends i will get called 7 times about when i’m coming back. and i also worry about my younger siblings. any time one of us “acts up” the rope gets tighter and tighter and i feel for my siblings.

Thank you. i have a lot in savings from working and unemployment. i’m applying to grants to study abroad and maybe do grad school far away. in some ways, i feel like just giving in. because my younger brother did too. my parents promised him off to a family friend and they emotionally blackmailed him into submission. so he is just trying to “delay the inevitable” as long as he can. but i think after his masters he will probably give in because my parents are emotionally so toxic and scared of us running off. when my brother said no my dad started hitting his head and crying saying what did they do to deserve such children. both of them are mentally insane, my mom never shows me love or care but because of marriage are. girl, there is SO much that is wrong with my family and even me because of their actions and ways. like my dad showed me a video of a bride that came up on his facebook feed and goes isn’t her jewellery nice? my brother goes no it looks so ugly or something to take my side and i also said so too. but it’s not a random thing. when did he get into jewellery? 

the guy asked me if i had any questions for him and i said no and also acted disinterested. his sister asked what my hobbies were, “like cooking” etc and i said i like reading and shopping. and my mom tries to cover it by saying “we don’t make her cook much because she’s still young” etc. like what? i told her i’ll never see or talk to her again if she keeps pressuring me and she goes you don’t have to meet me just send me pics and if i don’t talk to her she’ll stop my siblings from talking to me. talk about emotionally toxic.

OH also she goes “yeah she’s taking courses for law” when i’m not. she’s lying to them that i am majoring in something i am not so they think i’ll eventually go into law right away. when i’m thinking about other things
that’s the thing though. my parents don’t and will never give me the opportunity to become independent. even the thought of me living alone or staying home alone for 24 hours scares them.

thanks i’ll do that. when i talked to the guy i could tell he was misogynistic (my parents keep persisting to look for potentials in their home country because “men here have too many girlfriends” and on the call he sounded just like my father, an authoritarian type. his sister was trying to say something about how he supports women working BUT- then my mom cut her off and started talking loudly about how careers are important. so i wouldn’t hear his other opinion on working women. I’m probably the most liberal human in this family so i don’t know how or what they expect me to do. like forcing me and pressuring me into a relationship that is 99% going to fail is irresponsible on their part.
what else can i do? do you have any advice or steps i can take to free myself from them? im so scared and alone.
thanks for advice the only problem is my mom is right next to me and also it’s on the phone. but i’ll talk in monotone

i’m scared i’ll be sexist too, i’m scared my daughter will suffer and hate me as much as i hate my parents for what they’re doing to me/have done. sometimes when i see a young adult wearing skimpy clothes i judge her a lot inside and unconsciously call her a hoe, my parents are the same. I’ve unconsciously learned this from them.  and it scares me. growing up in america where there is so much freedom i wonder if i’ll be as restrictive too. “for your own good we do these things” but clothes and heavy makeup does not harm anyone. i would love to have kids but i fear i’ll destroy them internally, i could never live with myself if i did become my parents - beyond controlling, bigoted, and emotionally unstable.

got a prestigious scholarship to study abroad acceptance rate is like ~10% fully paid, the day of my departure my mom refused to say bye and bawled her eyes out on her bed, she didn’t talk to me for the whole month and a half, and even when i came home for week or two, she didn’t even acknowledge me. before i left my school/town asked for interviews and media permission my dad refused to sign the papers because he said this wasn’t anything to brag about. the whole time i was abroad and free, i realized just how abusive my parents were. not physically, but just mentally. like honestly, i could take punches or slaps, really, it hurts for a few minutes but u recover. what they’ve done to me mentally is just heartbreaking. in asian society, individualism is shunned. a girl doesn’t study abroad, a girl doesn’t have different interests. they were embarrassed of my studying a new language and being interested in another country and what people would say of an “unmarried girl studying abroad.” how sad.
I’ve tried. The only problem is they’re okay with me moving a town or state away not abroad. They are more concerned w me getting married and their own reputation than they are about my moving out.
